This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="TROS" />

==Biology and appearance==
This sentient species was distinguished by the pair of prehensile cheek tentacles extending down from their ears and past their chin.<ref name="Tweet" /> They possess mottled [[Color|gray]] and blue skin. They also donned distinctive [[helmet]]s that covered their entire face, though the purpose of these helmets is currently unknown.<ref name="TROS" />

==Species in the galaxy==
During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire]], a member of this species could be found on the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]], employed at the shady location known as "[[The Den]]" in [[Daiyu City]]<ref name="Kenobi">{{Kenobi|Part II}}</ref> by [[9 BBY]],<ref name="KenobiDate">{{KenobiDate|I}}</ref> obliviously working when [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] snuck past them to rescue a young [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] who was being held in one of the building's back rooms.<ref name="Kenobi" /> Another member of this species could be found sharpening a blade at [[Borgo Prime|Port Borgo]] shortly after the young castaways [[Wim]], [[Neel]], [[Fern]], and [[KB]] initially arrive<ref name="Skeleton Crew">{{SkeletonCrew|Way, Way Out Past the Barrier}}</ref> around [[9 ABY]].<ref name="MandoDate">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="TROSDate">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'' to [[35 ABY]].</ref> yet another member of this species attended the [[Aki-Aki]] [[Festival of the Ancestors]] on [[Pasaana]], being present when [[Rey Skywalker]] and company arrived on their [[Mission to Pasaana (Resistance)|mission]] to track down a [[Sith wayfinder]].<ref name="TROS" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Tentacled-Species-NK-Concept.png|thumb|right|250px|Concept art by Jake Lunt Davies]]
The species made their debut in the [[2019]] film ''[[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker]]'', directed by [[J.J. Abrams]].<ref name="TROS" /> This species was originally designed by concept artist [[Jake Lunt Davies]] and first portrayed by creature performer [[Nick Kellington]].<ref name="Instagram">{{Instagram|username=jakeluntdavies|url=p/CLR7ZaOD6XR|name=[[Jake Lunt Davies]]|date=2021-02-14|quote=Unused character from The Rise of Skywalker.
